Chapter 411: Chapter 19: Far-Reaching Impact (Please Subscribe)

“`

“If you have something to say, just say it.”

Seeing the black-haired elder hem and haw, Wanyang Holy Son did not blame him.

Now that he saw hope in catching up with the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master, comprehending a part of a Supreme Being’s body would definitely stir his emotions.

Then, with the support of his own Nine Yang Divine Meridian, stepping into the Seventh Rank within a century was no joke.

As for the Eighth Layer that came after the Seventh Rank, Wanyang Holy Son had yet to consider it, as the Eighth Layer was still too far away for him.

...

Mental Will Index, Inner World, Flesh Soul Perfection, etc., none was yet fulfilled.

Currently, Wanyang Holy Son’s gaze was entirely focused on the Seventh Rank, as long as he could step into the Seventh Rank, he would have narrowed the gap with the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master.

“Rest assured, there’s no bad news right now that can shake my spirit.”

Seeing the black-haired elder still hesitating, Wanyang Holy Son spoke calmly.

With newfound hope, Wanyang Holy Son felt his Spirit Will had also improved.

The so-called living through long years and tempering one’s Spirit Will is essentially experiencing great ups and downs.

Life-and-death crises are the same.

Upon hearing that the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master had stepped into the Seventh Rank, Wanyang Holy Son once fell into despair and even risked his life to cultivate in seclusion within a star.

This was the “fall.”

And now, having learned that there was a Supreme Being’s body to comprehend,

The possibility of catching up with the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master in the future was the “rise.”

Great falls and great rises,

are just that.

“It’s bad news related to the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master…”

The black-haired elder said tentatively, knowing how much Wanyang Holy Son longed to catch up with the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master.

But the news he had just received, to Wanyang Holy Son, was perhaps too cruel.

“The Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master?”

Wanyang Holy Son’s expression became slightly more solemn.

Bad news related to the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master?

Could it be that the adversary has already stepped into the peak of the Seventh-Rank King Level?

That really isn’t good news.

In such a short time, to progress from the early stage of the Seventh Rank to the King Level Peak, befitting of the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master he was chasing after.

At this rate, a hundred years later, wouldn’t the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master have the hope to step into the Seventh-Rank Marquis Level?

By then, even if everything goes smoothly for him, he would only be at the beginning of the Seventh Rank, the gap between him and the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master would still be considerable.

At the thought, Wanyang Holy Son couldn’t help feeling the pressure.

“I’ve received a message; the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master, he seems to have stepped into the Eighth Layer?”

The black-haired elder mustered up his courage to convey the news he had just received.

Even if he didn’t mention it, as long as Wanyang Holy Son connected to the virtual network, he would still find out.

“The Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master stepped into the Eighth Layer… What did you say? Stepped into which layer?”

Wanyang Holy Son, still mulling over how he was going to advance swiftly towards the Seventh-Rank Marquis Level a hundred years later, almost thought he was hallucinating when he heard the black-haired elder’s words.

The Eighth Layer?

The Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master stepped into the Eighth Layer?

Wanyang Holy Son’s mind was muddled.

It wasn’t until the black-haired elder repeated himself several times that Wanyang Holy Son barely recovered.

“Where did this news come from?”

Wanyang Holy Son’s first reaction was disbelief.

The transition from Seventh to Eighth Rank is a major bottleneck.

If the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master had already been at the Seventh-Rank King Level Peak before he entered seclusion,

It would be normal now to have broken through to the Eighth Layer.

But it’s well known that the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master just stepped into the Seventh Rank not long ago.

To cross these three great thresholds – Spirit Will, Inner World, Flesh Soul Perfection – in such a short time?

Is this still human?

Is this still human?!

“Your Highness, this news was transmitted from the Chikun Main Star; a fluctuation of aura that signals a breakthrough from the Seventh Rank to the Eighth Layer was detected on the Central Continent of the Main Star, and only the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master fits the conditions for this breakthrough from the Seventh Rank to the Eighth Layer…”

The black-haired elder spoke truthfully.

“In that case.”

“Could it be a mistaken transmission?”

Wanyang Holy Son immediately asked.

He truly did not want to believe that the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master had already stepped into the Eighth Layer.

That made his previous life-risking seclusion seem laughably foolish.

Still chasing the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master?

With what will he chase him?

“There is indeed a possibility of a mistaken transmission.”

The black-haired elder thought for a moment and then nodded.

“Your Highness, if the Thirteen Peaks’ Peak Master has truly broken through to the Eighth Layer, the Red Kun Lineage will soon issue a public announcement, and by then everything will be clear,” he said.

“Then let’s wait.”

Wanyang Holy Son fell silent for a while and then spoke.

“Okay.”

“We wait.”

The black-haired elder nodded.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Thirteen Peaks.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

At this moment, his aura was incredibly profound, like a celestial body, beginning to influence the surroundings.

An Evolver at the Eighth Layer, whose Physical Soul had undergone ultimate metamorphosis and with an Inner World unfolded—if one didn’t contain their aura, indeed, there was little difference between them and the cosmic celestial bodies.

“Is this the Eighth Layer?”

Lin Yuan carefully felt the brand-new power within him.

Although at the Seventh Rank, with his vast Inner World, Lin Yuan could crush most of those at the Eighth Layer,

That was merely suppression of power, but the subtleties of the Realm, Lin Yuan was now experiencing.

The greatest trump card of an Eighth Layer Evolver is the Inner World, but that’s not to say that Eighth Layer Evolvers possess only Inner World techniques.

“The cultivation at the Eighth Layer mainly divides into four stages: the early stage, the middle stage, the late stage, and the Peak stage.”

Lin Yuan clearly knew how the road ahead should be traversed.

In fact, the Eighth Layer has a fifth stage.

That is the invincible state of the Eighth Layer.

Essentially, the invincibly at the Eighth Layer still belongs to the fourth stage.

The invincible Evolvers at the Eighth Layer, such as the Chikun Star Lord, Golden Dragon Star Master, Wanyang Star Lord, and others, have mastered some form of power that transcends the Eighth Layer.

With this power, the invincible ones can crush all Eighth Layer Evolvers.
